description: This file contains custom Cypress commands for mocking API responses, user authentication, and seed data setup in the dashboard application's test suite.

methods.name: mockApi
methods.description: Sets up intercepts for various API endpoints to mock backend responses for login, users, reports, and charts.

methods.name: loginUI
methods.description: Performs login through the UI by filling in the email and password fields and clicking the sign-in button.

methods.name: seedAuth
methods.description: Directly sets a fake JWT token in local storage to simulate authenticated state without UI interaction.
